scheme_name: BIRAC’s E-YUVA Fellows (for under graduate students)
other_conditions: Indian students pursuing undergraduate studies in any domain from Indian Institutes/colleges must apply as a team
Each team must consist of a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 5 students
The team must be supported by a mentor/guide
All fellows must spend 3‑4 weeks at an EYC/EYC Knowledge Partner during the fellowship period
If team members are from different colleges/institutes, each institution must have an E‑Cell/Institutional Innovation Council/Incubation centre
benefits_summary: Quarterly stipend of INR 7,500 per student and an annual research grant of INR 2,50,000 per team, along with continuous mentoring and support services.
